title: AI out-persuades expert humans in text-based dialogue
description: Reproduction repository for the paper "AI out-persuades expert humans in text-based dialogue": the full analysis pipeline (data -> results -> figures + tables) and a de-identified export of the study data, including the follow-up survey, the example conversations and Pangram scores (without post text) for the r/PoliticalDiscussion analysis. Code is released under the MIT License; the de-identified data under data/ are released under CC BY 4.0. See README.md and code/redact_data.R for details.
